description.zh: 容量预定服务的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the capacity reservation. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 容量预定服务的失效时间，仅`EndTimeType=Limited`时该参数生效。时间格式以ISO8601为标准，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。更多信息，请参见[ISO8601](~~25696~~)。
description.en: The expiration time of the capacity reservation. This parameter takes effect only when `EndTimeType` is set to Limited. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC. For more information, see [ISO 8601](~~25696~~).

description.zh:
容量预定服务的失效方式。取值范围：

- Limited：指定时间释放。必须同时指定`EndTime`参数。
- Unlimited：手动释放。不限制时间。
description.en:
The release mode of the capacity reservation. Valid values:

- Limited: The capacity reservation is automatically released at the specified point in time. If you configure this parameter, you must also configure `EndTime`.

- Unlimited: The capacity reservation must be manually released. You can release it anytime.

description.zh:
容量预定服务需要预留的实例总数量。取值范围：已使用的实例数量~1000

> 扩充实例总数量时，可能因库存不足导致扩充失败。
description.en:
The total number of instances for which capacity is reserved. Valid values: the number of used instances to 1000.

> When you increase the number of instances, the increase may fail due to insufficient resources.

description.zh:
实例使用的镜像的操作系统类型。取值范围：

- Windows：Windows Server类型的操作系统。
- Linux：Linux及类Unix类型的操作系统。

> 该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The operating system of the image used by the instance. Valid values:

- Windows

- Linux

> This parameter is unavailable.

description.zh: 容量预定服务的名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The name of the capacity reservation. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 容量预定服务所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the capacity reservation. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
容量预定服务的生效方式。目前仅支持设置为立即生效，且参数无需传值。

> 该参数不传值即表示设置为立即生效。
description.en:
The mode in which the capacity reservation takes effect. Only immediate capacity reservations are supported. You do not need to specify a value for this parameter.

> If you do not specify a value for this parameter, the capacity reservation immediately takes effect.

title.zh: 修改一个容量预定服务的部分信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-capacity-reservation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-pool-options-id crp-bp67acfmxazb40000 --private-pool-options-name eapTestName --description This_is_description. --start-time Now --end-time 2021-10-30T06:32:00Z --end-time-type Unlimited --platform Linux --instance-amount 100 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyCapacityReservation --region cn-hangzhou --Description 'This_is_description.' --InstanceAmount 100 --EndTime '2021-10-30T06:32:00Z' --EndTimeType Unlimited --Platform Linux --PrivatePoolOptions.Name eapTestName --StartTime Now --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PrivatePoolOptions.Id 'crp-bp67acfmxazb40000'
